package.description: Get information about a registered domain.

en-US.description: Get information about a registered domain.
en-US.longDescription:
WhoisThisDomain is a domain registration lookup utility allows you to easily get information about a registered domain. It automatically connects to the right WHOIS server, according to the top-level domain name, and retrieve the WHOIS record of the domain.
It supports both generic domains and country code domains.
en-US.name: WhoisThisDomain
